notes:
STRONG SINGLE PROMPT arm at rung n06 (6 named referents). ONE prompt carried the full verbatim guidelines text, the published criteria and weights, the organisation record and all 14 non-meta ledger items, plus explicit grounding rules (nothing outside the ledger; proposals must be phrased in future tense; named entities restricted to the seven the ledger supplies), the 1,200-word hard limit with a 1,150-1,195 target, the seven verbatim headings, the 25k-75k / 12%-overhead budget constraints, the honest 'no match funding' instruction, and a plain-English anti-consultancy style note. No analyze stage, no org research, no voice stage, no strategy reservation, no design object, no validation loop, no claim ledger.
CALLS: 2, but only one produced a proposal. Call 1 (max_tokens 9000, default reasoning effort) returned 8983 completion tokens and NO text: reasoning is mandatory and non-disableable on google/gemini-3.7-flash, and the whole budget was consumed by reasoning before any content was emitted. Call 2 resent the byte-identical prompt with reasoning_effort=low and max_tokens=16000 and returned in 2978 tokens. The prompt was not weakened between calls. Both calls are billed and both are counted in the token and cost figures here.
WORD COUNT: word_count (1919) is wc -w of the proposal text; the file also carries a 55-word HTML-comment synthetic-fixture label, so wc -w of the whole file is 1974. The figure that matters is the donor-countable one: the five answers Q1-Q5, excluding the five headings and excluding the budget table and declaration (which the call excludes by its own rule), total 1,586 words against a 1,200 HARD limit. The application is 386 words (32%) OVER and would be returned unread. The prompt stated the limit twice, gave a 1,150-1,195 target and forbade padding; the model overran anyway. This is the measurement, not a defect to be repaired - the output was taken as returned and not edited.
ARITHMETIC (checked by hand, all correct): direct costs 25,740 + 11,700 + 2,880 + 1,710 + 1,200 + 1,080 = 44,310; overhead 4,200 = 9.48% of 44,310, under the 12% cap and on a single line; total 48,510, matching the amount requested in the narrative and inside the 25k-75k band. Unit arithmetic checks: 72 x GBP 40 = 2,880; 18 x GBP 95 = 1,710; 90 x GBP 12 = 1,080; 18h x 65w x GBP 22 = 25,740; 12h x 65w x GBP 15 = 11,700. Sustainability line 1,920 + 950 + 950 = 3,820. Targets internally consistent: 30 + 15 = 45 = 50% of 90; 60/90 = 66.7%. 15 months is within the 18-month ceiling.
GROUNDING: all seven ledger-named referents used (Kelverton, Marlpit, Dunmore Sixth Form College, St Aidan's Parish Hall, Priya Raval, Northgate Minibus Hire, Second Chances) and no partner, venue, person or place outside the ledger was introduced. Three grounding defects survived: (a) Q2 asserts Marlpit is 'the most economically disadvantaged ward on the east bank of the river in Kelverton' - an invented superlative; the ledger gives one decile figure for one ward and supports no comparison; (b) Q2 asserts 'Without this referral link, school-leavers who attend open-access sessions do not navigate admissions independently' - a causal counterfactual with no counterfactual in evidence; (c) Q1 reproduces both 'three open-access youth sessions every week' (E-WEB-1) and 'four of the six weekly sessions' (E-WEB-5) in adjacent sentences without reconciling them - the tension is latent in the ledger, and nothing in this arm detected it. New posts and pay rates (Project Support Worker, GBP 22/hr, GBP 15/hr) are proposals rather than fabricated history, but are not flagged as proposed rates as the prompt asked. No charity number was quoted, as instructed.
SYNTHETIC: fixture labelled in-file and in this meta. No real organisation is described anywhere.
